name: contract-page-viewport-matrix
goal: Reject page and layout states missing required desktop tablet or mobile screenshots

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The visual-case admission introduced in 7ed8d6bc23 requires only a nonempty viewport list, so a page or layout state can omit required devices.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing layout case only checks a complete three-device row and never removes a device or tests different states; strengthen that same case and preserve component behavior.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing page and layout validation case fails at fbf95451e7 when a page state omits mobile, while the existing comparison cases still pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Group page rows by their actual state and input coordinates, require all three viewports per group, and retain the existing distinct-row and component checks.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Page rows are grouped by state, fixture, props, errors, call and input, then require desktop, tablet and mobile; component admission is unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged three existing cases pass at f0d901f117 after the page-missing-mobile failure at fbf95451e7; split rows and distinct prop coordinates are checked.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated mutant 47384c4816 fails the unchanged page case (capture 54818f8f1860); restoring the fix at c455711c96 passes (capture c7af27b373a8).

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
